audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart shows Fizz on all seven rows while content layer and packet agree on [Fizz, Skill, Ryze, Skill, Skill, Ryze, Ryze] — rows 2-7 disagree, including two rows whose full whys already argued Ryze under a Fizz label.
audit.why: Packet levelChart matches content; content whys are kit-grounded (root beats hop once Flux lands; Ryze out-scales at items).
audit.corrected: Sides aligned to content with paired why rewrites.

audit.why: Spikes (level 3 root window, level 6 coinflip, first-item survival, late kite) are grounded and mutually consistent.

audit.whatIsWrong: Missing interactions flagged: Playful/Trickster untargetability dodging your commit and the Seastone Trident auto-reset burst tell; cooldowns field has no digit.
audit.why: Kit: E 16s rank 1 (8s max), untargetable; W 7s auto-reset; R 120s.
audit.corrected: Folded into cooldowns, dontsFull[2].d, and enemyWin with real numbers.

edits.before: - Fizz Playful / Trickster: matchup-defining — The untargetable hop dodges your whole combo — bait it before spending your burst. Check it before every step-up. - W Rune Prison is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Fizz Playful / Trickster: 16s at rank 1, 8s at max — the untargetable hop dodges your whole combo; bait it before spending burst. - W Rune Prison is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - Chum the Waters is 120s — respect the shark window.

edits.before: E the wave, Q the flux bounce, and W-root if he steps to answer — three-spell trades that end before his combo starts.
edits.after: A centered wave keeps his Q-E entry long and the flanks lit — Fizz kills through fog and 550-range dashes, not even waves.

edits.before: Spending W on poke and then face-tanking the engage it was born to stop — rootless Ryze is a Tear with a health bar.
edits.after: At half HP inside Q range one W-reset auto into the hop deletes you — his E is 16s, so greed only when you saw it spent.

edits.before: Flash + Teleport, always — Ryze is a scaling map champion and TP doubles the thesis. Nothing else is defensible on him.
edits.after: Flash + Teleport, always — Ryze is a scaling map champion and TP feeds the same map plan. Nothing else is defensible on him.

edits.before: Fizz wins by landing Playful / Trickster, denying your pattern, and starting the fight your kit wanted ten seconds later.
edits.after: Fizz wins by dodging your root with Playful / Trickster, then bursting with the W-reset auto before your combo cycles back.

edits.before: W online: the point-blank root answers anyone who closes. Trade Q-W-Q only when his engage tool is down.
edits.after: W online, but the root is dodgeable pre-Flux — poke with Q, hunt his E-in trade, even until someone errs.

edits.before: E unlocks the real combo: E-Q flux chunks and the wave-bounce clears. The lane starts being yours to play.
edits.after: E unlocks the real combo: Flux-root him out of Playful/Trickster and dump the full burst — your kill window.

edits.before: Tear + Lost Chapter and the EQ machine hums — short-trade his every wave contact and walk away before the answer.
edits.after: Tear + Lost Chapter hums — trades ride on whether he baits your root before committing his hop. Short-trade, leave.

edits.before: Realm Warp online — you are now a map play waiting to happen. The lane is a timer: shove and warp somewhere profitable.
edits.after: Realm Warp online — his shark all-in and your warp answer cancel out on cooldowns. Shove and warp somewhere profitable.

edits.before: RoA spike: your combo chunks half bars and your root starts kill chains. Force the trades you spent five levels avoiding.
edits.after: RoA spike: you now survive his full combo and your root starts kill chains. Force the trades you spent five levels avoiding.

edits.before: Two items and you ARE the win condition: EQ deletes carries, W stops divers, and Realm Warp turns objectives into ambushes.
edits.after: Two items and you out-DPS his one combo: EQ deletes carries, W stops the dive, and Realm Warp ambushes objectives.

notes: Suspect names 'Chum the Waters' (twice) are false positives — that is Fizz's real R. win[N] rows already carry the target values, so side edits go alone per the chart rule. Full ratings on rows moved off Fizz were left as-is; if QA wants ratings re-centered toward 5-6/10 on the new Skill/Ryze rows that is a follow-up. spikes[0].text's claim that Rune Prison 'cannot be dodged by Playful/Trickster once it lands' left alone — plausibly about the projectile-less lock but not verifiable from kit text; recorded in unverified.
